
{{alias}}( document, pointer )
    Tests if a JSON Pointer resolves to a value in a document.

    Per RFC 6901, an empty string refers to the root of the document, and
    the function returns `true` for any valid object or array.

    The `-` token on an array references the position after the last element
    (i.e., a nonexistent element), and, thus, the function returns `false`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    document: Object|Array
        JSON document.

    pointer: string
        JSON Pointer string.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if a pointer resolves.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( { 'foo': [ 'bar', 'baz' ] }, '/foo/0' )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, '/foo' )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, '/missing' )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}( { 'foo': 'bar' }, '' )
    true

    See Also
    --------
